_comment: Signal sources for the content pipeline. Press feeds are curated Afro-Brazilian/Brazilian outlets (items tagged to a pillar by keyword match). Google News RSS queries are pillar-scoped and turned into news.google.com/rss/search feeds by signals.mjs (keyless, no manual setup). Edit freely — failed/empty feeds are skipped gracefully.
_pressNote: Alma Preta (almapreta.com.br/feed) is intentionally omitted — it sits behind Cloudflare bot protection that serves an HTML challenge to programmatic clients. Its articles still surface via the Google News queries below.

googleNews.pt: "identidade negra" OR "representatividade negra" OR negritude OR "consciência negra"
googleNews.en: "Black identity" OR "racial representation" OR "Black excellence" Brazil

googleNews.pt: "inteligência artificial" OR "segurança de dados" OR LGPD OR "governança de IA"
googleNews.en: "AI governance" OR "data privacy" OR "diversity in tech"

googleNews.pt: paternidade OR "paternidade negra" OR "pai presente" OR "paternidade ativa"
"reinvenção profissional" OR "transição de carreira" OR etarismo
googleNews.en: "career change after 40" OR "ageism workplace" OR "career reinvention"
